title: F-35C Lightning II (carrier)

sources.title: Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II (Wikipedia), cockpit and variants
JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The F-35C is the aircraft carrier version of the F-35, with a larger folding wing, a stronger landing gear and a tail hook. Its cockpit is that of the F-35A, and like the B it carries its gun in a pod; JoyPro takes its controls from the F-35B entry, so this guide follows the F-35B guide.
